original_test_intent: Validate 24 continuous hours of awake OS idle stability, rather than workload stress.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Disable hibernate and leave the operating system idle for 24 hours.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: No disallowed BMC/system error, hang, or blue screen.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with OS-specific no-sleep, idle and rollback requirements.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer supplies OS policy and approval; monitoring is automated.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 24-hour awake idle soak; Machine Time 1440 minutes matches the duration.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: OS-specific sleep policy, idle definition, heartbeat cadence, event allowlist, window and override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Any shorter project soak is recorded against 24 hours.

original_method: Disable hibernate and idle 24 hours; retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the existing project idle-soak monitor and OS-native supported power-policy controls, then restore the original policy.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Exact OS version must be confirmed.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Official OS power-management and event-log documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes policy change reversible and evidence continuous.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No replacement of idle with stress; 24-hour coverage remains.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: OS version, policy, heartbeat and allowlist.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A monitoring workload can invalidate idle conditions.

safety_boundaries: No unconditional command for an unverified OS
No log clearing or workload injection
no_automatic_retry: A failed soak is not automatically restarted.
engineer_owned_verdict: System engineer decides whether events meet the project criteria.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already separated human policy input from automated monitoring and preserved the exact idle intent.
